review.why: Converts PDFs to Markdown with a bundled script and extracts embedded images, folders included.
review.summary: Runs a bundled Python script (MarkItDown plus PyMuPDF) to turn a PDF into Markdown and a folder of extracted images before analysis, for single files or folders. Images are appended in a final section because the text has no reliable page markers. Includes a setup guide and troubleshooting table.
strengths: Honest about the limits: images are listed at the end, not inline
Batch mode for folders, with a rule to also handle other file types
cautions: No OCR: scanned PDFs give an empty body
Needs Python, markitdown and PyMuPDF installed
Tells the agent not to read PDFs directly, even for tiny files
